summary.title: Interacting one-loop QED photon self-energy and running alpha
summary.verdict: Ward transversality and b0^QED=4/3 exact; lattice b0 = continuum b0; leptonic Delta alpha matches PDG to <0.3% (hadronic running deferred to the QCD sector).

ward.statement: q_m Pi^{mn} = 0 identically (transverse => no photon mass); loop Ward identity, exact.

b0.statement: one-loop QED fermion bubble is exactly transverse (Ward: q_m Pi^{mn}=0) and gives b0^QED = 4/3 for one charged Dirac fermion; scalar-bubble calibration g=1 fixes the 1/16pi^2 normalisation. The abelian loop assembly is validated (exact), mirroring F162's b0=11 gluon gate.

trace.statement: explicit-gamma Dirac trace matches the numerator used in the b0 gate; Clifford {g,g}=2eta holds.

lattice.statement: Delta = B_rule - B_cont is q-flat (no residual log) => lattice b0^QED = continuum b0^QED = 4/3. The rule arccos kernel is grid-sensitive at small n (F162 caveat); the decisive point is Delta is a small constant, not a growing log.

running.statement: leptonic Delta alpha(M_Z) ~ 0.0314 (matches PDG leptonic 0.0315 to ~0.2%) => 1/alpha(M_Z)|lep ~ 132.7; the pull-down to the measured 128.927 is the HADRONIC vacuum polarisation (QCD sector, F151/F152), NOT the lepton loop. Stated, not faked.

P2b_gamma_trace.quantity: explicit-gamma Dirac trace vs bubble numerator

P3_lattice_b0_consistency.quantity: Delta = B_rule - B_cont (q-flat => lattice b0 = continuum)

P4_leptonic_running.note: leptonic only; hadronic piece is the QCD sector (F151/F152).
